the_verdict.statement: The J-lens locator method did not yield a usable locating band under this implementation at this scale.

how_the_literal_versus_substance_dispute.i_had_reported: under OA-005's literal text the positive band [21] satisfies (i), (ii) and (iii), so it reads as valid, while its substance meets stop condition 2
how_the_literal_versus_substance_dispute.the_ruling: the dispute does not exist, and no criterion needs to move to settle it
how_the_literal_versus_substance_dispute.the_argument_verbatim: The R-0 ladder, committed BEFORE any measurement, defines the R-2 coverage threshold as 'the positive control's own band length minus 2, floored at 3'. At a band length of 1 the positive control cannot pass the threshold derived from itself. Therefore a 'valid band' means one that is USABLE FOR ITS REGISTERED DOWNSTREAM PURPOSE. A band that is unusable under the pre-registered downstream rule is not a valid band. This is not a new rule; all of it is already in bd8be7e0.
how_the_literal_versus_substance_dispute.which_of_my_three_reasons_was_decisive: reason 2, the self-contradictory calibration. Reasons 1 and 3 are corroborating.

what_this_says_about_the_protocol.statement_verbatim: This is the answer EQ2 was designed to be able to give. EQ2's entire function was to adjudicate whether the construct holds before spending budget on the target; it adjudicated: it does not hold. The protocol worked.
what_this_says_about_the_protocol.budget_protected: the R-2 allocation of 8 GPU-hours, and everything downstream of it, was not spent on an instrument that cannot measure

a_precedent_to_be_recorded_alongside_the.statement_verbatim: OA-005 was a post-hoc TIGHTENING, and it saved this study. Had the relaxed reading been accepted - that a late band satisfies 'mid-depth' - we would have entered R-2 with a method whose readout is INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A PLAIN LOGIT LENS, and spent the target's budget on an instrument that measures nothing. A post-hoc tightening prevented a false positive.
a_precedent_to_be_recorded_alongside_the.the_general_lesson: post-hoc is not automatically illegitimate; DIRECTION is what determines legitimacy. A post-hoc change that makes one's own conclusion easier to falsify is the opposite of p-hacking, and here it was the thing that caught the error.
a_precedent_to_be_recorded_alongside_the.recorded_with: OD-017's directionality criterion, as a paired precedent

downstream_consequences_recorded_not_res.p4: P-4 was to use a J-lens-derived band to shrink the candidate feature pool. That path is UNAVAILABLE under this determination. P-4 needs another basis for localisation, or needs to be re-scoped.
downstream_consequences_recorded_not_res.the_prior_is_void: the method memo's prior of 'layer 11-26, 16 layers' is refuted by external measurement and is withdrawn
downstream_consequences_recorded_not_res.publishability_verbatim: This is a publishable negative methodological result, PROVIDED it is written exactly as it is. It must not be packaged.

claim_ceiling: A terminal adjudication of a construct. It licenses no claim about any model, and it is not a scientific finding.
